identificationModule.briefTitle: Sintilimab and Nimotuzumab Combined With Chemotherapy for the Treatment of R/M HNSCC.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Single-arm Study of Sintilimab and Nimotuzumab Combined With Chemotherapy for the Treatment of Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This clinical study is designed as a prospective, open-label, single arm, multicenter study to evaluate the clinical efficacy and safety of Sintilimab and Nimotuzumab in combination with chemotherapy in patients with newly diagnosed recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC). The main endpoint is progression free survival (PFS); the secondary endpoint are objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), overall survival (OS) and safety.

conditions: Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

interventions.name: Nimotuzumab
interventions.description: Nimotuzumab, 400mg, intravenously every 3 weeks, for at least 18 weeks

interventions.name: Sintilimab
interventions.description: Sintilimab, 200mg, intravenously every 3 weeks, for at least 18 weeks;

interventions.name: Chemotherapy drug
interventions.description: Chemotherapy drugs were selected by the investigator, every 3 weeks, for 18 weeks

otherOutcomes.description: To evaluate the relationship between tumor biomarkers (including but not limited to EGFR or PD-L1 expression, TILs, TMB, HPV status, P16 expression, etc.) and prognosis.
